subject: Post-demo: RTBF / data deletion requirements and next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-25T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up + RTBF specifics from today's demo

Hi Elena — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and a few clarifying Qs so we can align the MAP and legal review:

- Demo notes: you liked the private deployment option for customer data isolation and the automatic KV cache invalidation flow.
- RTBF ask: you mentioned customers may request deletion of all PII and derivative model traces. Can you confirm if the requirement is: (A) immediate purge of active data and caches within 24 hours, and (B) removal from backups within 90 days unless otherwise negotiated?
- Logs / audit: you need immutable audit records for access but redaction of any PII in debug logs — is that correct?
- Residency: FinTechCo data must be stored in us-east-1 for this proof-of-concept.

Next steps I propose: 1) we map requirements into the MAP and share with your legal; 2) Marissa will coordinate a short tech call next week with Logan to confirm backup/restore constraints; 3) I will include our deletion playbook and a proposed SLA exception for backups if needed.

Attaching a draft MAP and our data-deletion playbook for review.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: FinTechCo-MAP-20260330.pdf, redwood-data-deletion-playbook.pdf

From: Elena Ramos <elena@fintechco.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinTechCo Legal <legal@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-03-26T09:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + RTBF specifics from today's demo

Hi Camila — appreciate the summary and the docs. A few clarifications from our side (Legal looped in):

- Deletion timeline: We require customer-requested deletion (RTBF) to be completed from all primary systems and caches within 72 hours.
- Backups: We understand operationally backups may be retained. Our requirement is that any retained backups containing customer PII must be flagged and, upon verified deletion request, have a documented purge plan executed no later than 120 days. If there are technical blockers (e.g., immutable backups), we need a compensating control and a remediation timeline.
- Logs: Audit logs must be preserved for 1 year for compliance, but any PII in logs must be redacted within 30 days of ingestion.
- Data residency: Confirmed — us-east-1.

We also need a short statement confirming you do not train models on FinTechCo data for general model training (only transient inference caches permitted).

If you can confirm the items above and update the MAP, Legal will review and we can schedule a procurement kickoff next week.

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Head of Security Programs, FinTechCo
elena@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@fintechco.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-29T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + RTBF specifics from today's demo

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear requirements. Quick responses from the product/legal side:

- 72-hour active purge: feasible. Our private deployment can trigger immediate KV cache eviction and remove customer records from application-level stores within that window. We will need to document the API call and workflow for initiating a customer's RTBF.
- Backups (120 days): our standard backup retention is 90 days for snapshots, but we can offer a contractual 120-day purge commitment for this account with a limited SLA exception. If immutable backups are used (on-prem or certain partner-managed snapshots), we'll include compensating controls and a specified remediation plan. We'll confirm any technical blockers by EOD Friday.
- Logs: we can provide log redaction tooling and an onboarding checklist so PII is redacted within 30 days, and full audit log retention for 1 year.
- Model training: we do not use customer inference data to update any general training pipelines. We will include an explicit non-training statement in the MAP and add it to the contract.

Action items: Logan — can you prepare a short tech note that explains backup snapshot behavior, immutability constraints, and the exact process to request a backup purge (who signs off, what manifests are required)? I'll fold that into the MAP and send to FinTechCo Legal.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-30T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + RTBF specifics from today's demo

Thanks everyone — technical note attached. TL;DR:

- Backup behavior: snapshots in our managed hosted accounts follow a 90-day rotation by default. For private deployments we can configure snapshot lifecycle policies; if the deployment uses immutable object-store retention, we will need an explicit purge plan and proof of deletion (snapshot manifest + storage provider deletion job).
- Purge workflow: RTBF request -> Auth'd API call from FinTechCo admin -> internal ticket -> active data purge -> backup manifest search -> schedule snapshot rewrite or targeted object deletion -> provide signed deletion evidence to FinTechCo. Typical window: 72 hours for active systems + up to 120 days for complete backup evidence and cleanup (unless earlier).
- Logs: recommend piping logs to a gated S3 bucket with automated PII redaction within 30 days; we can provide the Lambda scripts as part of onboarding.
